Description: Baseline frozen system with all epistemic modules active
Replaces DeBERTa NLI with neutral unresolved states
Replaces consensus confidence c0 with 1.0 (disables abstention)
Disables weakest-link DAG propagation (independent claim updating)
Stops retrieval after initial hop (single-hop epistemic)
Forces retrieval to always execute maximum hops (no early exit)
Uses raw claim string as search query instead of EIG proposal
